description: Invalid config while enabled is state error INVALID_CONFIG, never a throw (MCPWARP.md section 6 configure). An unset token or name is caught by configure() itself (no connecting); an invalid kind is caught when the connection starts (connecting first, no dial); an invalid config while online stops the connection; repeating it is no new snapshot. lastError is a constant and never echoes a value. An SDK whose kind type cannot hold "ftp" skips that event and the two snapshots it produces.

expect.lastError: The service name is not set.
The service name is not set.
